e2e.reason: no runnable application surface; CI workflow configuration only

surface_verification.justification: This change is GitHub Actions workflow configuration and the scaffolder that ships it. There is no runnable application surface: the executable surface is GitHub's workflow_run engine, which cannot be driven locally. Verification is the 38-assertion parsed-YAML invariant suite plus the 3-profile scaffold->deploy->derive composition test. The residual gap is recorded as behaviour 22 of the completeness ledger and fails CLOSED in production.

behaviors.behavior: oversize diff fails the job instead of skipping the review
a reviewer that exits non-zero fails the gate (`|| true` gone)
review output that will not parse fails closed
stage 1 holds no secret
stage 1 is not fork-guarded
stage 1 records the change for audit
stage 1 emits no `PR Review` check-run context
stage 1 carries no policy a contributor could edit
stage 2 is triggered by stage 1 completing
stage 2 never checks out the contributor's code
stage 2 takes identity from the trusted workflow_run event
stage 2 never reviews the artifact (contributor-controlled)
stage 2 derives the tier from API data in default-branch code
stage 2 refuses an ambiguous PR (one SHA, several open PRs)
stage 2 re-checks the head SHA before blessing it (force-push race)
stage 2 posts the verdict onto the PR and the required status
least-privilege tokens: stage 1 no write, stage 2 posting job only
the waiver cannot cover a change to the checks themselves
tier logic preserved across the move (labels/sensitive/external)
adopt scaffolds BOTH review stages
required-check derivation names the posted status, not a job name
stage 2 executes correctly against live GitHub on a real fork PR
behaviors.reason: needs a real fork PR against GitHub with live secrets; no local harness can synthesise a workflow_run event. The first live fork PR is the proof. Until then the gate fails closed, which is the safe direction.

ci_supplychain_ack.statement: Splits the Tier-3 PR review into two workflows. Stage 1 (pull_request, runs on forks) holds NO secret and no write scope; stage 2 (workflow_run, default-branch code) is the only credentialed half and widens solely to statuses:write + pull-requests:write + contents:read, preserving read-only top-level tokens with per-job widening. Adds .github/workflows/pr-review-run.yml. Action-pinning posture unchanged: GitHub-owned actions (checkout@v4, upload-artifact@v4, github-script@v7) stay on mutable tags per the recorded do-not-SHA-pin decision; the only third-party action (astral-sh/setup-uv) remains pinned to a full commit SHA. Net effect on the trust boundary is a REDUCTION: credentials move out of any run whose workflow file the contributor controls, and stage 2 derives tier and diff from the API rather than from contributor-supplied artifact data.
